We manufacture state-of-the-art Medical products that facilitate the caregiver's role in providing
the best outcomes in Hospitals for patients.

[Browse our products][23]

## Manufacturing superior products for over 40 years!

Amico was incorporated in 1981 to manufacture Industrial equipment for the construction industry.
Within 5 years, the company began a transition to manufacturing Medical products for the Health Care
Industry. In 1991, Amico discontinued its Industrial business to focus entirely on manufacturing
medical products for the Patient Rooms, Operating Rooms and the Emergency Rooms in a Hospital. By
2023, the company had grown significantly due to the needs of an aging population, new technology,
and the pressures imposed by the COVID pandemic. Today Amico manufactures a very broad range of
hospital products within a campus of 8 buildings occupying over 800,000 square feet.

# Bringing data to life

Integrated communication and collaboration solutions for enhanced safety and efficiency

## Mobility with confidence

Mobility isn’t just about movement - it’s about confidence in every step

[Find out more][239]
[Nurse looking at data on myco4 phone]

## We work every day to bring data to life

Every single second, Ascom systems generate 1.3 million data points. We are here to turn these into
useful and actionable information for people in the toughest operational environments – and assist
them to make the best possible decisions.

With solutions for [Clinical Surveillance][240], [Rapid response][241], [Alarm Management][242],
[Smart Nurse call systems][243], [Mobile Devices, ][244][Staff Safety][245] and [Activity
monitoring][246] – we make a difference every day, helping people care for others and keeping them
safe.

[Find out more][247]

## When accuracy isn’t optional

## The era of ventilator integration to the patient record

Sheffield Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust is one of the UK’s biggest providers of integrated
hospital and community-based healthcare, offering a comprehensive range of local and tertiary
services. Within the organization, the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) plays a critical role in
caring for the most vulnerable patients—newborns requiring advanced medical support due to
prematurity, congenital conditions, or severe illness.

[Read the full story][248]
[Play] Your browser does not support HTML5 video.

## Digital Transformation at Frosinone

As healthcare digitalizes, managing both clinical and personal alarms is key to ensuring safety,
prompt responses, and high-quality care. The experience of the Frosinone Local Health Authority in
Italy demonstrates how a structured approach can be adopted to coordinate the management of patient
safety events and incidents related to the protection of healthcare staff.

[Read the full article ][249]

## Employee protection as a competitive advantage

Discover why protecting lone workers is now essential for retention and compliance. Learn how
real‑time emergency response, man‑down alarms, and dedicated safety devices can strengthen your
organization’s safety culture.

[Unlock the full story][250]

## Reliable communication in explosive environments

Communication in ATEX classified environments is never just about a tool. It is the first line of
defense that protects people, supports compliance, and keeps operations under control. Newchem, a
leading Italian producer of active pharmaceutical ingredients, understands this reality. With the
Ascom solution, Newchem moved from broad warnings to clear alerts that support immediate action.
Fire safety systems, monitoring systems, and production equipment now connect into a single
environment that routes the right information to the right people at the right time.

[Read the case][251]

## We work every day to bring data to life

Every single second, Ascom systems generate 1.3 million data points. We are here to turn these into
useful and actionable information for people in the toughest operational environments – and assist
them to make the best possible decisions.

With solutions for [Clinical Surveillance][240], [Rapid response][241], [Alarm Management][242],

monitoring][246] – we make a difference every day, helping people care for others and keeping them
safe.

## When accuracy isn’t optional

## The era of ventilator integration to the patient record

Sheffield Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust is one of the UK’s biggest providers of integrated
hospital and community-based healthcare, offering a comprehensive range of local and tertiary
services. Within the organization, the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) plays a critical role in
caring for the most vulnerable patients—newborns requiring advanced medical support due to
prematurity, congenital conditions, or severe illness.

## Digital Transformation at Frosinone

As healthcare digitalizes, managing both clinical and personal alarms is key to ensuring safety,
prompt responses, and high-quality care. The experience of the Frosinone Local Health Authority in
Italy demonstrates how a structured approach can be adopted to coordinate the management of patient
safety events and incidents related to the protection of healthcare staff.

## Employee protection as a competitive advantage

Communication in ATEX classified environments is never just about a tool. It is the first line of

leading Italian producer of active pharmaceutical ingredients, understands this reality. With the
Ascom solution, Newchem moved from broad warnings to clear alerts that support immediate action.
Fire safety systems, monitoring systems, and production equipment now connect into a single
environment that routes the right information to the right people at the right time.

About Us

## Empowering Safer, Smarter Surgery

Founded more than 15 years ago in Berlin, Caresyntax began with a simple belief: surgery — one of
the most critical moments in a patient's life — deserved greater transparency, insight, and support.
While much of healthcare was becoming increasingly connected, the operating room remained largely
isolated. We believed surgical teams and patients deserved better.

What started as an effort to better understand what happens inside the operating room has grown into
a global commitment to advancing surgical care. From the beginning, our focus has been on supporting
surgeons, care teams, and hospitals with meaningful insights that help them learn, improve, and
deliver safer, more consistent care.

Over the years, we have partnered with leading hospitals, researchers, and surgical societies around
the world. Our work has contributed to peer-reviewed research in journals such as Nature Scientific
Reports, Surgical Endoscopy, and Annals of Surgery, reinforcing our dedication to evidence-based
progress in surgery.

A milestone in our journey came when the American Board of Surgery invited Caresyntax to support its
surgical coaching initiative at the American College of Surgeons Clinical Congress — a recognition
of our role in advancing surgical education and continuous improvement.

Today, Caresyntax operates globally with dual headquarters in Berlin and San Francisco. Across
thousands of operating rooms worldwide, we remain guided by the same purpose that inspired us from
the start: to make surgery smarter and safer for every patient, everywhere.

About Us

## Empowering Safer, Smarter Surgery

Founded more than 15 years ago in Berlin, Caresyntax began with a simple belief: surgery — one of
the most critical moments in a patient's life — deserved greater transparency, insight, and support.
While much of healthcare was becoming increasingly connected, the operating room remained largely
isolated. We believed surgical teams and patients deserved better.

What started as an effort to better understand what happens inside the operating room has grown into
a global commitment to advancing surgical care. From the beginning, our focus has been on supporting
surgeons, care teams, and hospitals with meaningful insights that help them learn, improve, and
deliver safer, more consistent care.

Over the years, we have partnered with leading hospitals, researchers, and surgical societies around
the world. Our work has contributed to peer-reviewed research in journals such as Nature Scientific
Reports, Surgical Endoscopy, and Annals of Surgery, reinforcing our dedication to evidence-based
progress in surgery.

A milestone in our journey came when the American Board of Surgery invited Caresyntax to support its
surgical coaching initiative at the American College of Surgeons Clinical Congress — a recognition
of our role in advancing surgical education and continuous improvement.

Today, Caresyntax operates globally with dual headquarters in Berlin and San Francisco. Across
thousands of operating rooms worldwide, we remain guided by the same purpose that inspired us from
the start: to make surgery smarter and safer for every patient, everywhere.

# Redefining what a healthcare company can do. 

Our products are just the beginning. Clinical expertise, technology and genuine commitment work
together to drive real outcomes for your team.

[Explore Our Products][76][Shop or Rent Products][77][Find Support][78]
[Baxter International Professional Site for US Healthcare Providers]

## Leading the Way with Our Most Connected Delivery System Yet

Working side by side with customers, we’re advancing connected solutions that enable patient safety
efforts, realize staff and task efficiencies, strengthen care coordination and enhance the clinician
and patient experience. Our approach unifies Baxter devices and applications onto one modern
platform, with solutions focused on these areas:

[The Centrella hospital bed in a med-surg unit]

### Connected Bedside

Smart beds, vital signs monitors, infusion pumps, nurse call and clinical communication systems can
integrate with electronic healthcare records and other hospital systems.

[Explore Smart Beds and Surfaces][79]
[A clinician places his hand on a patient’s shoulder while talking in a primary care office.]

### Connected Outpatient Office

Integrate data from vital signs monitors, enhance physical exams with digital tools and deliver
connected vision screenings and retinal exams.

[Explore Diagnostics and Examination Products][80]
[Cardiology Technician examines an ECG next to a patient with electrodes on his chest]

### Connected Cardiac Care

Connected cardiac care integrates data from multiple diagnostic devices and modalities, including
ECG and ambulatory monitoring.

[Explore Cardiac Care Solutions][81]

Diagnostics and Examination

## **Connex** 360 Vital Signs Monitor

With an upgradeable and expandable design, the **Welch Allyn Connex** 360 Vital Signs Monitor
features optimized clinician workflows for connected monitoring and enhanced security features.

[Connex 360 Vital Signs Monitor][82][All Diagnostics and Examination Products][83]
[Healthcare checking vitals on the Connex 360 and patient]

## **One portfolio.** Multiple categories. The right product for every need.

From beds and patient mobility to care communication, infusion, diagnostics, pharmaceuticals,
respiratory and surgical technologies, discover innovations that can soon transform care in your
setting.

Beds and Patient Mobility

Baxter’s smart beds, surfaces, and mobility products are the center of the connected patient room,
enhancing comfort, streamlining work and delivering important data to your team to aid in a faster
response.
* Smart Beds and Surfaces
* Patient Handling and Mobility
* Stretchers

[All Beds and Patient Mobility][84]
[The bottom of a Centrella bed, projecting lights on the floor]

Infusion Therapies and Technologies

Empower your team to deliver safe, efficient care with our connected infusion systems, IV fluids and
parenteral nutrition solutions, all backed by our broad supply chain network.
* Clinical Nutrition
* Infusion Systems and Accessories
* IV Solutions

[All Infusion Therapies and Technologies][85]
[Baxter Novum Syringe Pump]

Diagnostics and Examination

Equip yourself with trusted **Welch Allyn** exam tools, vital signs monitors, cardiac care devices
and vision screening systems designed to support better outcomes for your patients. Decades of
innovation and reliability come together to support every care setting, including the physician’s
office, clinic, hospital and urgent care.
* Patient Monitoring Solutions
* Cardiac Care Solutions
* Physical Exam and Diagnostics
* Vision and Retinal Screening 

[All Diagnostics and Examination][86]
[Healthcare worker with patient]

Care Communications

Get vital information to the right team with our unified suite of communications solutions that
connect patients, clinicians, devices and data across your entire organization. Solutions include
nurse call, hands-free communication, mobile communication and alert and alarm management.
* Nurse Call
* Mobile Applications
* Voice-Activated Communications
* Data Visualization and Management
* Precision Locating
* Patient Experience

[All Care Communications][87]
[baxter_voalte_nurse_call]

Pharmaceuticals

Our pharmaceutical products provide total coverage for your hospital, including anesthesia,
anti-infective, critical care and cardiac medications. These medicines are available from Baxter in
ready-to-use formulations, vials, cannisters and more.
* Premixed Medications
* Anesthetics
* Vials and Other Injectables
* Frozen Premixed Medications

[All Pharmaceuticals][88]
[Healthcare worker hangs an IV bag for chemotherapy]

Respiratory Therapy and Devices

Breathing should never be a barrier to living life fully. Our respiratory solutions support patients
by mobilizing secretions, easing the burden of chronic conditions and more. Treating conditions like
cystic fibrosis, bronchiectasis and neuromuscular disorders, our therapies help patients breathe
easily and live with confidence.
* Cough Assist Systems
* Airway Clearance Systems
* Patient Home Care Products

[All Respiratory Therapy and Devices][89]
[Patient breathing with respiratory asistance]

Surgical Equipment and Technologies

From emergency to elective surgeries, we offer surgical products and technologies to enhance
technique, help increase efficiencies and support patient recovery.
* Adhesion Reduction Technology
* Adjunctive Hemostats and Sealants
* Bone Repair Technology
* Lights and Booms
* Operating Room Integration
* Surgical Tables and Positioning Accessories
* Tissue Repair Technology

[All Surgical Equipment and Technologies][90]
[Surgeon in an operating room adjusts Helux Pro surgical light]

Care Communications

## **Voalte Linq** Device Powered by **Scotty** Assistant

**Voalte Linq** is next-gen, voice-activated technology for care teams, seamlessly integrating into
Baxter's ecosystem to support efficiency, safety and collaboration - so caregivers can focus on what
matters most: patient care.

[Voalte Linq][91][All Care Communication Products][92]
[FLC_Med-Surg_Nurse-Station]

Infusion Therapies and Technologies

## **IQX** Infusion Platform

The** IQX **Infusion Platform unites two proven technologies, the **Spectrum IQ **Large Volume Pump
(LVP) and the **Novum IQ** Syringe Pump (SYR), to create an enhanced infusion delivery ecosystem,
powered by the **IQ Enterprise** Connectivity Suite. 

[IQX Infusion Platform][93][All Infusion Therapies and Technologies][94]
[baxter_iqx_platform]

Beds and Patient Mobility

## **Dynamo Series** Stretcher

See what makes the **Dynamo Series** designed for the toughest. With features designed to help
support patient fall prevention, care team experience and patient comfort, the **Dynamo Series**
delivers a new standard of support where you need it most. 

[Dynamo Stretcher][95][All Beds and Patient Mobility Products][96]
[Healthcare worker helps a patient up from a Dynamo Series Stretcher]

Driven by compassion and powered by innovation, we deliver connected solutions that transform
healthcare. By uniting life-saving technologies with the professionals who use them, we help improve
outcomes, streamline workflows and create meaningful advancements for patients everywhere.

connected vision screenings and retinal exams.

[Explore Diagnostics and Examination Products][80]

ECG and ambulatory monitoring.

features optimized clinician workflows for connected monitoring and enhanced security features.

with long-term needs to live more independently, and with an improved quality of life

[
About Us

# Connected Health

Our expertise in IP and mobile solutions enables a broad range of digital and health care services
to suit all needs

# Connected Care

Our solutions have been designed to support a wide range of people, including older people, those at
risk of falls, with limited mobility and conditions such as dementia, and those who care for them

[
Connected Care
][38]

## Redefining Connected Care & Health

For over 65 years, Tunstall Healthcare has pioneered the use of technology to support those
requiring care & health intervention to live independently in their chosen home setting. The aim is
to balance independence with reassurance, and provide tailored support which meets individuals'
needs now and in the future.

Our solutions and services enable independent living, by defining new models of care and creating
connected global healthcare solutions which support more than five million people daily.

[Learn more][39]

## Connected Care

Our innovative range of care solutions and services enable people to live more independent and
fulfilling lives. Whether it's in an individual’s home or in residential care, our proactive and
integrated approach provides 24/7 monitoring and support to deliver efficient and responsive care.

Learn more

## Connected Services

Our connected services enable organisations to achieve the next level of care and health
transformation, building on many years of experience and research gained across international care
and health organisations. We use data and insight to focus resources, enabling person-centred models
of care.

## [Tech for Aging: 2009 – today? What happened and what’s next?][235]

Thu, 07/23/2026 - 11:08 - Laurie Orlov

**Looking back to see the future.  **Tech for older adults has been a market category for a long
time.  It is documented in a [2009 Market Overview][236] as ‘Tech for Aging in Place’ and is
accompanied by a categorized [list of tech companies][237] that fit the needs of older adults at
that time.  What is striking about this report? It’s basic assertions are unchanged – people want to
remain in their own homes, as independent as possible.  The cost of long-term care was daunting and
largely out of reach in 2009.  Assisted living cost was $36K/year in 2007 and was projected to grow
to $51K by 2015.  Actually, it exceeded $75,000 in 2026, still largely paid out of pocket from
savings and social security income – [today only 3% of Americans have long-term care
insurance][238].

## [Will baby boomers need a Check-in app?][246]

Thu, 07/16/2026 - 10:31 - Laurie Orlov

**Living alone and fall risk.**  Today [43% of women aged 75+ live alone][247] – that is, in their
own home versus a senior living community. They are [more likely to live alone than in other
countries.][248]  However, only 9 percent use a personal emergency response device, with [no change
over the past few years.][249] And for those devices, the key customer is the adult child. And this
is despite fall risk which grows with age, though the recent [Senate initiative does not
differentiate among older age groups.][250]

## [Why simple startup of new tech should matter to developers][260]

Thu, 07/09/2026 - 09:32 - Laurie Orlov

**How important is a smart watch?  **Last year the [Apple Watch turned 10][261].  By then it was in
use by [23% of the smartwatch market worldwide.][262]  And (likely many) more than [17% of US
Internet households own an Apple Watch][263]. Imagine – it is the only watch that has outsold the
Swiss watch industry! It is increasingly used by many (particularly younger people) for
health-related encouragement… ‘STAND! You exceeded your last week’s steps!’  And who previously had
such an easy way to check your resting heart rate, know the outside temperature and UV, all at a
glance?

## [Don't be fooled -- Older adults’ comfort with technology has skyrocketed][269]

Wed, 07/01/2026 - 15:46 - Laurie Orlov

**An email from a startup founder offered this observation about older adults’ comfort with
technology:** “The user experience gap between what a product promises in a press release and what a
78-year-old will actually pick up and operate is where most elder care technology quietly fails.” 
Not true. If it provides a much-wanted experience like a chat with a grandchild, most older adults
will deal with the hassle factors of downloading and using any software. If it involves an app to
enable signing up for a desired exercise class, most will deal with the hassle. Long ago, one tech
provider told her mother that if she didn’t use the check-in software, she would have to move her to
assisted living. She got the message and provided regular updates.

## [Women in IT – 2026 participation is the same as 1986][277]

Thu, 06/25/2026 - 10:26 - Laurie Orlov

**You wo****uld think that women were playing a sizable role in tech by now.  **You would be wrong.
 And historical trends underpin the delta between men and women in tech. Despite early interest in
the 1970s, including computer programming, by the [mid-1980s women were disappearing from computer
science programs][278].  Consider reasons that are offered, including the possibility that recently
introduced personal computers were more likely to be bought for boys than girls. Note the
[reinforcement from Apple ads][279] (no kidding) about what these computers could do for the career
dreams of boys.

## [Tech for Aging: 2009 – today? What happened and what’s next?][235]

Thu, 07/23/2026 - 11:08 - Laurie Orlov

**Looking back to see the future.  **Tech for older adults has been a market category for a long
time.  It is documented in a [2009 Market Overview][236] as ‘Tech for Aging in Place’ and is
accompanied by a categorized [list of tech companies][237] that fit the needs of older adults at
that time.  What is striking about this report? It’s basic assertions are unchanged – people want to
remain in their own homes, as independent as possible.  The cost of long-term care was daunting and
largely out of reach in 2009.  Assisted living cost was $36K/year in 2007 and was projected to grow
to $51K by 2015.  Actually, it exceeded $75,000 in 2026, still largely paid out of pocket from
savings and social security income – [today only 3% of Americans have long-term care
insurance][238].

countries.][248]  However, only 9 percent use a personal emergency response device, with [no change
over the past few years.][249] And for those devices, the key customer is the adult child. And this
is despite fall risk which grows with age, though the recent [Senate initiative does not

## [Don't be fooled -- Older adults’ comfort with technology has skyrocketed][269]

Wed, 07/01/2026 - 15:46 - Laurie Orlov

**An email from a startup founder offered this observation about older adults’ comfort with
technology:** “The user experience gap between what a product promises in a press release and what a
78-year-old will actually pick up and operate is where most elder care technology quietly fails.” 
Not true. If it provides a much-wanted experience like a chat with a grandchild, most older adults
will deal with the hassle factors of downloading and using any software. If it involves an app to
enable signing up for a desired exercise class, most will deal with the hassle. Long ago, one tech
provider told her mother that if she didn’t use the check-in software, she would have to move her to
assisted living. She got the message and provided regular updates.

**You wo****uld think that women were playing a sizable role in tech by now.  **You would be wrong.
 And historical trends underpin the delta between men and women in tech. Despite early interest in
the 1970s, including computer programming, by the [mid-1980s women were disappearing from computer
science programs][278].  Consider reasons that are offered, including the possibility that recently
introduced personal computers were more likely to be bought for boys than girls. Note the
[reinforcement from Apple ads][279] (no kidding) about what these computers could do for the career
dreams of boys.

## **FAQ**

**What is an audio-visual system?**

An audio-visual (AV) system consists of various equipment for enhancing communication through
visuals and sound. These may include screens, projectors, speakers, and other audiovisual devices.
AV systems are commonly found in meeting rooms, conference venues, and public buildings like
schools, banks, and post offices.

**What are the requirements of AV?**

AV requirements refer to the specific criteria or specifications that need to be met by an
audiovisual system. These requirements can vary based on the event or the layout of a building. They
may encompass factors such as audience size, room setup, presentation content, and the need for a
podium or fixed microphone.

**What does AV installation involve?**

AV installation involves an assessment by an AV technician to determine the most suitable equipment
and configuration for your specific needs and budget. During the installation service, the AV
installer will set up and operate the new AV system, providing training as needed. They may also
offer ongoing maintenance and repair services for the system.

**What is AV tech?**

facilitate sound and visual functions. This includes speakers, projector screens, interactive
whiteboards, PA systems,

## **FAQ**

**What is an audio-visual system?**

An audio-visual (AV) system consists of various equipment for enhancing communication through
visuals and sound. These may include screens, projectors, speakers, and other audiovisual devices.
AV systems are commonly found in meeting rooms, conference venues, and public buildings like
schools, banks, and post offices.

**What are the requirements of AV?**

AV requirements refer to the specific criteria or specifications that need to be met by an
audiovisual system. These requirements can vary based on the event or the layout of a building. They
may encompass factors such as audience size, room setup, presentation content, and the need for a
podium or fixed microphone.

**What does AV installation involve?**

AV installation involves an assessment by an AV technician to determine the most suitable equipment
and configuration for your specific needs and budget. During the installation service, the AV
installer will set up and operate the new AV system, providing training as needed. They may also
offer ongoing maintenance and repair services for the system.

ATS is a trusted leader in safety & security solutions, ensuring top-notch service.

# Prepared to protect. Trusted to respond.

Tampa Bay's Family-Owned Fire & Security Specialists since 1988

[Get a Free Consultation ][69]

#### Our Legacy

## A Commitment to Integrity and Community

At A Total Solution, we've always prided ourselves on being more than just a business; we're a
community grounded in a culture of integrity, people-first values, and family-oriented principles.

[Image][Image]

#### Family-Owned Business

We take pride in representing not just legacies but also the family behind ATS since 1988.

[Image][Image]

#### 30+ Years Serving Tampa

ATS is a trusted leader in safety & security solutions, ensuring top-notch service.

[Image][Image]

#### Customer-First Approach

Our well-trained team ensures every safety & security need is met with care & the customer's best
interest.

[Image][Image]

#### Why Choose Us

## As a Leader in Life, Safety & Security Systems, ATS Has Become the Premier Choice in Tampa Bay

Finding a unified team of fire and security industry specialists, all dedicated to a shared vision,
is rare. We take pride in being a comprehensive fire, life safety, and security organization, and we
are grateful for the trust businesses like yours place in us to safeguard your people and assets
against unforeseen dangers.

[About A Total Solution ][70]

#### What We Offer

## Our Services

##### 01

### Fire Protection Systems

ATS provides comprehensive business fire protection services, including installation, maintenance,
inspections, and 24/7 emergency repairs.

[Learn More ➜][71]

##### 02

### Security Systems

ATS services and installs commercial access control systems, offering customized, sophisticated
solutions and 24/7 emergency service in the Tampa Bay area.

[Learn More ➜][72]

##### 03

### Healthcare Systems

ATS designs, installs, and maintains nurse call systems for healthcare facilities, offering reliable
emergency communication solutions with certified technicians since 1988.

[Learn More ➜][73]

#### Our Reputation

## A Legacy of Integrity and Family-Oriented Principles

We want our customers to think of us an an extension of their own staff, with our qualified, trained
team available to resolve every aspect of customer's security and fire protection needs- twenty-four
hours a day, every day of the year. It's all part of our "complete customer satisfaction"
philosophy.

[Read Our Client Tesitomonials ][74]

  job and ensure that we were in compliance and our system worked as it should is extremely
  appreciated.  We were impressed with their attitude and energy and look forward to working with
  you in the future."

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.

## National Supplier of Nurse Call & Life Safety Systems

# ** National Provider of Nurse Call and Life Safety Systems**

BEC Integrated Solutions, LLC provides nurse call and life safety systems to healthcare facilities,
institutions, and commercial buildings nationwide. We provide direct system sales and design
guidance for new construction and facility-wide replacements, supporting organizations that manage
installation internally or work with their preferred contractors. From planning through long-term
repairs and replacement parts, we support the complete lifecycle of critical communication systems.

## System Design, Replacement, and New Construction

We assist healthcare and institutional facilities with system planning for new construction
projects, facility-wide replacements, and infrastructure upgrades. Our team provides product
selection guidance and direct equipment sourcing to support efficient implementation and long-term
system performance.

## Nurse Call and Life Safety System Solutions

### [Nurse Call Systems][5]

We provide complete wired and wireless nurse call systems for healthcare and institutional
facilities nationwide. Our solutions include the **[BEC Wireless Nurse Call platform][6]** and
**[TekTone wired nurse call systems][7]**, supported with system design guidance for new
construction and full-system replacements. For facilities operating legacy platforms, we provide
repair services and pre-owned replacement parts for systems such as Rauland, Hillrom, and Ascom,
helping extend system life while planning long-term upgrades.  

### Commercial Panic Button Systems

We offer panic button systems for healthcare facilities, retail environments, offices, schools, and
institutional settings. Our solutions support emergency notification, staff protection, and security
compliance requirements, with direct equipment sales and system planning guidance.

### [Wander Management Systems][8]

Wander management systems, also referred to as patient wandering systems, are designed for
hospitals, assisted living communities, and memory care facilities. These systems help monitor and
protect at-risk patients while supporting staff response and facility safety protocols. We provide
system design guidance and equipment for both new installations and facility upgrades.

### [Area of Refuge Systems][9]

Code-compliant area of rescue communication systems for multi-story and commercial buildings. We
support both new construction and retrofit applications with reliable emergency communication
infrastructure.

### [Commercial Intercom & Building Entry Systems][10]

Commercial intercom and building entry systems for healthcare facilities, multi-tenant buildings,
offices, and institutional properties. As a supplier of [Aiphone intercom systems][11], one of the
world’s leading building communication platforms, we support apartment entry, visitor management,
and secure internal communication with system design guidance and direct equipment supply for new
construction and upgrades.

### [Access Control Systems][12]

Linear access control systems and components for secure facility entry management. Our solutions
support healthcare facilities, commercial buildings, and institutional properties with scalable
access control infrastructure, providing system planning guidance and direct equipment supply for
both new construction and system modernization projects.

### Over 20 Years Supporting Healthcare and Facility Infrastructure

For more than two decades, BEC Integrated Solutions has supplied nurse call and life safety systems
to healthcare facilities, institutions, and commercial organizations nationwide. We work directly
with facilities, contractors, and maintenance teams to provide system design guidance, equipment
supply, and long-term system support.


Our experience spans new construction projects, facility-wide replacements, and ongoing service for
both current and legacy platforms. With nationwide reach and specialized product knowledge, we
support organizations seeking reliable, cost-effective communication and life safety infrastructure.

### What Our Clients Say

I’ve been working with BEC Integrated for years and they have truly proven to be an exceptional
partner for Attention Button systems. Their product is top-notch and enhances safety across the spa
industry. Their customer service really sets them apart. The team is incredibly responsive and makes
communication effortless. I can’t recommend them enough!

Jane Crupi

Pre-opening Project Coordinator

## Nurse Call & Code Blue

In case of a medical emergency, quick response time is crucial. Our wireless nurse call and code
blue panic buttons offer the perfect solution. Our user-friendly system allows for fast and
effective communication between nurses and caregivers, providing peace of mind for patients and
their families. With the touch of a button, our system can alert healthcare providers for fast
response time in the event of an emergency. Don't wait until it's too late. Invest in our wireless
nurse call and code blue panic buttons today for the safety and wellbeing of your patients. Contact
us now to learn more and get started.
[ Learn More ][41]

## Retirement Care

Don't let your loved ones be caught without help in an emergency. Our retirement solution offering
provides them with the peace of mind they deserve. Our panic button alerts nursing staff and
security the moment its pressed, ensuring assistance is on the way as quickly as possible. With its
hassle-free wireless design, it's the perfect solution for anyone living in a retirement village. So
why wait? Order today and enjoy the security of knowing your loved one is just a button press away
from help when they need it most.
[ Learn More ][42]

## Security

Keep your retail store secure and give your employees peace of mind with our wireless panic buttons.
Our panic buttons are the perfect addition to any retail space. When pushed, they send an immediate
alert to your mall's security control room, notifying them of the panic. This quick response can
help prevent potential emergencies from escalating, ensuring the safety of everyone involved. With
our wireless panic buttons, your employees can work with confidence, knowing they have a reliable
method of calling for help if needed. Don't wait until it's too late, invest in our security
solution today!
[ Learn More ][43]

## Retail

Our innovative product is designed to revolutionize the customer queuing experience in supermarkets.
With the help of a wireless call button, every customer can be notified when it is their turn to
move to the pay point. This means there will be no more waiting in long lines or getting frustrated
with the slow pace of service. Our product helps to improve the efficiency of customer service in
supermarkets and guarantees a smooth and hassle-free shopping experience. By using our product,
supermarket managers can reduce queues and increase customer satisfaction. It is easy to install and
operate, making it an ideal solution for every supermarket checkout point. We offer a 2-in1 solution
that allows the cashier to call both the customer or the supervisor to the checkout. Upgrade your
customer service and streamline the checkout experience with our queue management system.
[ Learn More ][44]

## Hospitality

Our wireless call button system is the perfect solution for restaurants and hospitality businesses
looking to improve their customer service. With our easy to use call buttons, patrons can quickly
and discreetly request assistance from their server, ask for the bill, or request to speak to the
manager. Not only does our call button system improve the customer experience, but it also increases
the efficiency and productivity of your staff by streamlining communication between patrons and
staff members. Upgrade your restaurant's service and enhance your customer experience with our
wireless call button system. Contact us today to learn more about how we can help your business.
[ Learn More ][45]

## Corporate

Transform your corporate meetings with our wireless call button system. Our product ensures that
your meetings run smoothly by allowing hosts to request assistance at the touch of a button. No
longer will you have to interrupt a meeting to search for support staff. Simply press the button to
request refreshments, IT support or cleaning services. Our call button system is sleek and
easy-to-use, making it the perfect addition to any boardroom. Improve the productivity and
efficiency of your meetings with our innovative wireless call buttons.
[ Learn More ][46]

### The new standard in

### nurse call systems

iCall2 is the next evolution of our trusted iCall platform, a **fully **
**IP-based nurse call system** designed for modern healthcare environments.
**Developed and manufactured in Belgium**, it combines **speed, safety, and flexibility**
to connect every caregiver, resident, and device within a single intelligent network.

[Learn more][33]

## Same nurse call,

### other DNA

When we started to develop a brand new nurse call system,
we decided to create a completely different approach to nurse calls,
covering all the disadvantages we’ve seen in other nurse call systems:
iCall is based on the open IP standard and offers a huge flexibility in product range,
cable topology and openness for integrations.

This **unique 3-in-1 wireless nurse call solution** combines
**RTLS, RFID & BLE**.
iTrack is developed for wireless call transfers and patient,
staff and asset tracking.

[Learn more][36]

 

### Discover iCall’s
### new Room Unit

### with SIP Speech

iCalls call response by SIP Speech will increase staffs efficiency to detect
the reason of the room call before stepping into the room.

[Learn more][37]

## How we can help you?

IndigoCare offers the most flexible solutions for nurse call and notification, for retrofit or new
buildings:

### Nurse Call

With its wide range of products, from the economical I/O modules up to the IP-Room terminals with
touch screen and SIP speech, iCall Nurse Call offers a solution for every need. In retrofit or new
buildings.

[EMEA range][38] [USA range][39]

### Notification

The Netrix Notification Gateway collects every nurse call or other alarms and sends the alarms to
the staff’s dect handset pager, e-mail, sms text or to the Androids mobile nurse desk. Netrix offers
time- or profile based routing capabilities.

[Read more…][40]

## A rich history

IndigoCare designs and manufactures the most flexible IP-Based nurse- and alarm-call systems in the
world, fit for new buildings and retrofit.

[Read more...][41]

### A new approach

Since 1977 the original company Essec Healthcare has been a system integrator on the Belgian market
integrating nurse call, notification and telephony systems.

In 2005 we realised that the nurse call manufacturers weren’t proceeding on a technological level at
the same speed as the PBX manufacturers were: the big move to IP wasn’t there at all, while quite
some end users started asking for it. Since none of the nurse call manufacturers had any plans
towards IP technology we decided to develop and manufacture our own nurse call system: iCall was
born. A new company was founded to establish R&D, production and channel management: IndigoCare.

## flexible product range

**Full IP communication platform** that replaces and improves the traditional nurse call systems.

**Open standard**: smooth integration with all kinds of systems such as fire alarm systems, building
management systems and different notification systems.

**Developed and manufactured in Belgium**, it combines **speed, safety, and flexibility**
to connect every caregiver, resident, and device within a single intelligent network.

[Learn more][33]

## Same nurse call,

### other DNA

When we started to develop a brand new nurse call system,
we decided to create a completely different approach to nurse calls,
covering all the disadvantages we’ve seen in other nurse call systems:
iCall is based on the open IP standard and offers a huge flexibility in product range,
cable topology and openness for integrations.

[EMEA range][34] [USA range][35]

# Discover iTrack

### Unique 3-in-1 wireless nursecall solution

IndigoCare brings you iTrack.
This **unique 3-in-1 wireless nurse call solution** combines
**RTLS, RFID & BLE**.
iTrack is developed for wireless call transfers and patient,
staff and asset tracking.

[Learn more][36]

 

### Discover iCall’s
### new Room Unit

### with SIP Speech

iCalls call response by SIP Speech will increase staffs efficiency to detect
the reason of the room call before stepping into the room.

[Learn more][37]

## How we can help you?

IndigoCare offers the most flexible solutions for nurse call and notification, for retrofit or new
buildings:

### Nurse Call

With its wide range of products, from the economical I/O modules up to the IP-Room terminals with
touch screen and SIP speech, iCall Nurse Call offers a solution for every need. In retrofit or new
buildings.

[EMEA range][38] [USA range][39]

### Notification

The Netrix Notification Gateway collects every nurse call or other alarms and sends the alarms to
the staff’s dect handset pager, e-mail, sms text or to the Androids mobile nurse desk. Netrix offers
time- or profile based routing capabilities.

[Read more…][40]

## A rich history

IndigoCare designs and manufactures the most flexible IP-Based nurse- and alarm-call systems in the
world, fit for new buildings and retrofit.

[Read more...][41]

### A new approach

Since 1977 the original company Essec Healthcare has been a system integrator on the Belgian market
integrating nurse call, notification and telephony systems.

In 2005 we realised that the nurse call manufacturers weren’t proceeding on a technological level at
the same speed as the PBX manufacturers were: the big move to IP wasn’t there at all, while quite
some end users started asking for it. Since none of the nurse call manufacturers had any plans
towards IP technology we decided to develop and manufacture our own nurse call system: iCall was
born. A new company was founded to establish R&D, production and channel management: IndigoCare.

## IndigoCare’s
## flexible product range

IndigoCare develops the latest technology in call and notification systems for any healthcare
facility.

**The most economic solution.** More than 97% of the cabling can be reused. Its distributed
architecture ensures the highest degree of flexibility.

**New generation nurse call**, a multi module system for a total solution approach.

**iCall is a 100% Belgian product.**

**Full IP communication platform** that replaces and improves the traditional nurse call systems.

**Open standard**: smooth integration with all kinds of systems such as fire alarm systems, building
management systems and different notification systems.

### A broad spectrum of case studies

We have installed bases all around the world: Algeria – Angola – Argentina – Austria – Bahrain –
Belgium – Bolivia – Bulgaria – Burkina Faso – Canada – Chile – Colombia – Croatia – Cyprus – Czech
Rep. – Djibouti – Egypt – Estonia – France – Gabon – Germany – Greece – Guatemala – Iceland – India
– Indonesia – Iraq – Israel – Italy – Ivory Coast – Jordan – Kuwait – Lebanon – Libya – Lithuania –

Spain – Sweden – Switzerland – Trinidad and Tobago – UAE – UK – USA – Yemen – Zimbabwe

#### Cure

iCall has been installed in numerous hospitals throughout the world, in retrofit as well as in new
buildings.

#### Care

iCall integrates video doorphone and combines intelligent IP-or LocalBus call units with wireless
transmitters for manual calls or wanderer detection. Ideal for Care homes…

[View case studies][42]

## Worldwide presence

If your country is not listed, contact us via the contactform.

### The **MOST FLEXIBLE** nurse call

for providing a high level of patient care in medical and social institutions.

specific solution, especially restaurants, hotels, schools, banks,buidlings and factories.

MEEYI works with thousands of customers across six contents and in over 40 countries – from
hospitals, medical cares, nursing homes, restaurants,schools and so on.

Nurse call system bedside tablets enhance patient care by providing an intuitive interface for
communication, service requests, and entertainment. Patients can easily contact caregivers, control
room settings, and access medical information, all from their bedside. These tablets streamline
workflow for healthcare staff by automating routine tasks and integrating with electronic medical
records (EMRs). With features like multilingual support and accessibility options, they ensure a
seamless experience for all users. Bedside tablets are a modern, scalable solution, improving
efficiency and patient satisfaction in hospitals and healthcare facilities.

patients and caregivers. It processes and routes requests, ensuring timely responses and efficient
workflow. Designed for reliability and scalability, the host integrates with bedside devices, mobile

## [Physical / Virtual solution][107]

MobiCall is a professional alarm management and response solution that protects against fire,
emergency, silent alarms, lone worker risks and critical infrastructure monitoring.

# [MOBIBOX][108]

## [Physical solution][109]

MobiBox is NewVoice’s on-premise alerting solution, essential in critical situations such as fire
alarms, emergency calls, personal security and technical failures.

# [MOBICLOUD][110]

## [Virtual solution][111]

MobiCloud is a cloud-based solution for alert management, evacuation and people protection. It
provides monitoring and mass alerting capabilities via cloud services.

alarms, emergency calls, personal security and technical failures.

Responder

workflows and coordinate care across units. With integrated devices and software, it supports
connections among caregivers, patients, and hospital systems.

[Learn More][29]

Telecenter

everyday operations and emergency response. Connect classrooms, offices, and campuses through a
unified system built for speed, reliability, and safety.

Integrations

Health systems benefit from reduced complexity of managing multiple technologies and healthcare
teams. The Rauland VIP Program allows participating vendors to connect devices, software, and
platforms with Rauland solutions, ensuring interoperability across the healthcare ecosystem.

# Transforming Care and Learning Through Smart Communication Technology

Rauland delivers advanced communication and workflow solutions that enhance safety, efficiency, and
responsiveness across hospitals and schools.

 

Our smart, interoperable platforms connect teams, streamline critical processes, and support better
outcomes for patients, staff, and students. By unifying essential communication pathways, we empower
organizations to operate with greater clarity, coordination, and confidence.

WMS are a nationwide, independent company dedicated to offering a wide range of expertise in the
design, installation, and commissioning of equipment designed to protect the elderly and infirm,
allowing them to live independently in supported accommodation.

We have a committed management team and a highly trained and motivated workforce that is dedicated
to a level of service and customer satisfaction that is unsurpassed.

Control, Warden Call, CCTV and Surgery Call manufacturers we also design and manufacture our own
extensive range of bespoke products. This means that we can offer an informed, independent,

Ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) are health care facilities that offer patients the convenience of
having surgeries and procedures performed safely outside the hospital setting. This trend in
healthcare is a growing new market and TekTone has designed our systems to offer valuable nurse and
emergency call capabilities to ASC patients.

[ASC][29]

Continuing Care Retirement Communities (CCRC), also known as Life Plan Communities, are designed for
seniors who are currently living independently, but want the safety and security of being cared for
as they age without having to relocate. As a resident’s health declines, he or she may transition
from an independent living residence to assisted living, to an intermediate or skilled nursing
facility—all on one campus. TekTone offers systems specialized in adapting to the changing needs of
CCRCs, while keeping resident’s safety and security a top priority.

[CCRC][30]

A skilled nursing facility (nursing home, convalescent home, care home or rest home) provides a
place of residence for those who require continuous nursing attention. Services available in skilled
nursing facilities include assistance of nurses, nursing aides and assistants; physical,
occupational and speech therapists; social workers, recreational assistants; and living space. In
some instances, residents may reside in skilled nursing facilities to receive rehabilitation or
other therapy following an illness or accident.

[SKILLED NURSING][31]

Assisted living / independent living facilities usually have a campus-wide call system so a resident
can notify caregivers by initiating a call from a personal pendant or emergency button press/pull.
The systems specified for these types of facilities are usually referred to as emergency call
systems or personal emergency response systems. Call system requirements in assisted/independent
living vary, but may be mandatory in some states. Assisted living facilities may prefer a
combination of Tek-CARE wireless and wired technology, with pull-cord stations, call buttons and
wireless pendants to ensure staff members are notified efficiently and quickly.

[ASSISTED LIVING][32]

Nurse call systems for hospitals, microhospitals and cancer centers must offer more than the ability
for a patient to call for a nurse. These systems are now about total solutions to improving facility
performance. Performance is identified as improving efficiency in terms of facility goals (rounding,
reducing time to answer calls, tracking staff performance using metrics), improving staff
satisfaction, and improving patient satisfaction.

[HOSPITAL INFO][33]

Nurse call systems in high security facilities, such as psychiatric and behavioral health
facilities, require the implementation of advanced features to protect against vandalism and to
provide accurate monitoring and reporting options.

[PSYCHIATRIC & BEHAVIORAL][34]

TekTone‘s National Accounts Program is specifically structured for organizations that have multiple
facilities. Whether you are a local, regional or national organization, our national account program
provides you with high quality healthcare communications and a world-class service network.

[NATIONAL ACCOUNTS][35]

emergency.

Welcome to

For over 50 years, TekTone® has designed & manufactured high-quality, affordable, completely
interoperable healthcare products including nurse call, wireless nurse call, wander management, and
alert integration, as well as other affordable quality systems including emergency call, apartment
entry, and area of rescue assistance systems that are used in a wide range of applications.

[Our Products][98]

#### Nurse Call & Emergency Call

TekTone has UL Listed Nurse Call and Emergency Call equipment to meet the needs of hospitals,
nursing homes and assisted-living facilities.

#### Wander Management

TekTone’s Tek-CARE®700 system lets dementia and at-risk residents move freely about your facility,
while preventing them from wandering off.

#### Alert Integration Management

Tek-ALERT® Integration Manager allows a facility to seamlessly integrate calls and activities from
all systems and route those calls appropriately.

#### Apartment Entry Systems

Our apartment entry systems include 3-, 4- and 5-wire speaker station versions, and vandal-resistant
systems.

Committed to Providing Quality Intercommunication Solutions

TekTone—a proven leader in the nurse call, health care, and intercommunications fields since
1973—welcomes you to its diverse family of innovative systems. From a manufacturing plant and sales
office in NC, our network of first-rate distributors and representatives stretches worldwide.

### V-Guardian Alert: A Complete Solution for Emergency Notification

V-Guardian Alert provides instant access to help when every second matters. With a discreet,
wearable panic button, staff can quickly trigger alerts and communicate emergencies from virtually
anywhere in your facility.

Designed for schools, healthcare environments, hospitality hotels and casinos, and industrial sites,
V-Guardian Alert helps improve response times, enhance situational awareness, and support safer
workplaces. The system integrates seamlessly with your existing Valcom communications
infrastructure, including paging, notification, and emergency response systems.

Best of all, V-Guardian Alert is easy to deploy, simple to use, and scalable to meet your
organization’s unique safety requirements.
